title: Undirected stable edge weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho \in [-1,1]$, and let $x,y \in \{−1,1\}^n$. Define the undirected stable edge weight of $x$ and $y$ at parameter $\rho$ to be the sum of the stable edge weight from $x$ to $y$ and the stable edge weight from $y$ to $x$, using parameter $\rho$ in both directions.
